exercise.rubric: <font color="#000000">Match the descriptions with the words on the right.</font>

questions.sentence: <font color="#000000">This is the money of a country, such as the dollar or the euro.</font>[currency]
<font color="#000000">A building to store goods before they are delivered </font>[warehouse]
<font color="#000000">A letter, email, or message that proves something has happened </font>[confirmation]
<font color="#000000">A person in a company that you usually talk to. </font>[contact]
<font color="#000000">When you send goods, you include this document with the order.</font>[delivery note]
<font color="#000000">You agree these conditions for the transfer of money. </font>[payment terms]
<font color="#000000">Stock-keeping unit, a technical term for 'item number' </font>[SKU]
